roots.title: Root sessions
lang.label: Language
kids.title: Child sessions
kids.emptyRoot: Create a root from the sidebar: its child sessions will appear here.
kids.empty: This root has no child sessions yet. It creates them with orch spawn, for example through the create-specialist-session skill.
tools.restartTitle: Restart the session with the chosen model: the conversation is kept
ov.bad.title: Session exited unexpectedly
ov.bad.body: The conversation is saved and resumes on restart.
ov.warn.title: No heartbeat for over 60 s
ov.warn.body: The process is alive but not responding. Restarting keeps the conversation.
ov.off.title: Session stopped
ov.off.body: Stopped on request. Starting it resumes the same conversation.
split.title: Drag to resize
orphans.title: Orphans
issue.in-fallback: Session is using a fallback model.
issue.mcp-profile-edited: MCP profile was edited outside the orchestrator.
issue.followed-move: Followed the session to its new folder.
issue.copied-new-identity: Copied folder needs a new session identity.
issue.role-changed: Folder role changed; restart to apply.
issue.model-missing: Configured model is no longer available.
issue.unmanaged-sessions: Unmanaged sessions found in this folder.
issue.relocation-failed: Could not move the session file.
issue.relocation-blocked: Session relocation is blocked by an SDK mismatch.
issue.hello-missing: Session did not report its identity.
issue.catalog-partial: Catalog could not be fully refreshed.
edit.title: Edit
archive.confirm: Archive {route} and its {n} child session(s)? They stop and move to _archive in the workspace; nothing is deleted.
archive.busy: A session is working. Stop it anyway and archive?
wiz.title: New root session
wiz.mission: Mission — what should this root orchestrate?
wiz.missionPh: e.g. watch the inbox, draft replies for my approval, escalate anything ambiguous
wiz.mcpHint: MCP servers this root may use directly (children get their own profile at spawn).
wiz.skillHint: Skills for this session. Everything is on by default; uncheck to exclude a skill from this session only (omp's own skills included).
wiz.disabledInConfig: disabled in omp config — checking enables it here
tools.stopSubtree: Stop this session and its children (graceful)
tools.killSubtree: Force-kill this session and its children
tree.stopConfirm: Stop {route} and its {n} child session(s)? Children stop first, then the parent; omp is given time to save.
tree.killConfirm: Force-kill {route} and its {n} child session(s)? Only for stuck sessions: they are stopped immediately.
wiz.folderHint: Leave empty to create the folder inside the workspace. With a path (e.g. /Users/me/VSC/ODOO18) the session runs there and the workspace keeps a link: move or archive the link, the folder stays put.
